post_ipo.disclaimer: Not from the S-1 — post-IPO facts from SpaceX's subsequent SEC filings (8-Ks, first 10-Q), as of September 16, 2026.

cursor_acquisition.note: Per 8-K Items 2.01/3.02 (Aug 14, 2026): Cursor common/preferred converted into 389,289,254 Class A shares; vested Cursor RSUs converted into 1,752,426 Class A shares (prior to tax withholding). Unvested awards assumed as ~29,128,326 Company RSUs and ~44,365,047 options (not counted as outstanding). Approx outstanding = S-1/A No. 2 total (12,520,309,620) + 391,041,680 = 12,911,351,300 (~12.91B).

super_compute.label: Super Compute / Super Compute Centers
super_compute.rebrand_of: Orbital AI compute / orbital data centers
super_compute.thesis: Terrestrial DC sites reprice land from ~$3,000 to ~$180,000/acre on announcement; terrestrial power-generator lead times ~3 years. Orbit: free real estate, continuous solar in sun-synchronous orbit, passive deep-space radiative cooling; Starship reusability is what makes commercial Super Compute viable.
super_compute.roadmap_note: AI compute satellites / orbital compute testing targeted for 2027 (Shotwell).

risk_factors_unproven_markets_summary: Super Compute (orbital AI compute), lunar economy, Mars transport — non-existent technologies.
